passages.title: A Rainy Evening
passages.text: We planned to meet after work, but the rain was heavy. Instead, we cooked dinner at home and talked about our weekend plans.
passages.levelRationale: A familiar past event includes contrast and a change of plan.

chunks.text: We planned to meet after work, but the rain was heavy.
Instead, we cooked dinner at home and talked about our weekend plans.

passages.title: The Right Platform
passages.text: I arrived early, but my train was not on the main board. A station worker checked my ticket and showed me the correct platform.
passages.levelRationale: The passage narrates and resolves a common travel problem.

chunks.text: I arrived early, but my train was not on the main board.
A station worker checked my ticket and showed me the correct platform.

passages.title: Trying a New Recipe
passages.text: Last night, I tried a soup recipe from a friend. It took longer than expected, but the fresh vegetables and herbs tasted wonderful.
passages.levelRationale: A personal experience uses comparison and connected past-tense details.

chunks.text: Last night, I tried a soup recipe from a friend.
It took longer than expected, but the fresh vegetables and herbs tasted wonderful.

passages.title: Sharing the Calendar
passages.text: Our team started using a shared calendar this month. Now everyone can see important deadlines, and we spend less time asking about meeting dates.
passages.levelRationale: A workplace change is explained with a clear cause and result.

chunks.text: Our team started using a shared calendar this month.
Now everyone can see important deadlines, and we spend less time asking about meeting dates.

passages.title: Cleaning the Riverbank
passages.text: On Sunday, our neighborhood group collected trash beside the river. We filled twelve bags and learned why plastic waste is dangerous for local birds.
passages.levelRationale: A concrete community event adds a simple environmental explanation.

chunks.text: On Sunday, our neighborhood group collected trash beside the river.
We filled twelve bags and learned why plastic waste is dangerous for local birds.

passages.title: Checking the Project
passages.text: I finished the first part of the project yesterday, but I still need to check a few details. Could we meet after lunch to discuss the next steps?
passages.levelRationale: A workplace update combines completed work, remaining tasks, and a polite request.

chunks.text: I finished the first part of the project yesterday, but I still need to check a few details.
Could we meet after lunch to discuss the next steps?

passages.title: A Login Problem
passages.text: The new website works well on my phone, but I cannot sign in from my laptop. Could you check whether my account has the correct access?
passages.levelRationale: The speaker explains a technical problem and requests a specific check.

chunks.text: The new website works well on my phone, but I cannot sign in from my laptop.
Could you check whether my account has the correct access?

passages.title: Changing a Flight
passages.text: My meeting ends later than I expected, so I may miss the evening flight. I would like to move my booking to tomorrow morning, if possible.
passages.levelRationale: The passage gives a reason, predicts a consequence, and makes a polite request.

chunks.text: My meeting ends later than I expected, so I may miss the evening flight.
I would like to move my booking to tomorrow morning, if possible.

passages.title: Quiet Mornings
passages.text: I prefer to exercise early because the streets are quiet and the air feels cooler. Starting this way also helps me concentrate during the morning.
passages.levelRationale: A personal preference is supported with two clear reasons.

chunks.text: I prefer to exercise early because the streets are quiet and the air feels cooler.
Starting this way also helps me concentrate during the morning.

passages.title: A Package for My Neighbor
passages.text: A package arrived while my neighbor was away, so I kept it safely inside. I sent her a message and asked when she wanted to collect it.
passages.levelRationale: A short narrative explains actions, sequence, and a practical question.

chunks.text: A package arrived while my neighbor was away, so I kept it safely inside.
I sent her a message and asked when she wanted to collect it.

passages.title: Remembering My Bottle
passages.text: I started carrying a reusable bottle to reduce plastic waste. At first I often forgot it, but now I leave it beside my keys every night.
passages.levelRationale: A changed habit is described across time with contrast and purpose.

chunks.text: I started carrying a reusable bottle to reduce plastic waste.
At first I often forgot it, but now I leave it beside my keys every night.

passages.title: Asking for Clarification
passages.text: I understand the first two steps, but the final instruction is unclear. Could you show me an example before I update the rest of the files?
passages.levelRationale: The speaker identifies a precise gap and politely asks for clarification.

chunks.text: I understand the first two steps, but the final instruction is unclear.
Could you show me an example before I update the rest of the files?

passages.title: The Weekend Market
passages.text: The outdoor market is usually crowded, but I enjoy meeting local farmers there. Their produce is fresh, and they often explain how each item was grown.
passages.levelRationale: An opinion is supported by details and a relative clause in a familiar setting.

chunks.text: The outdoor market is usually crowded, but I enjoy meeting local farmers there.
Their produce is fresh, and they often explain how each item was grown.

passages.title: A Better Video Call
passages.text: During yesterday's call, several people could not hear the speaker clearly. For our next meeting, I suggest testing the microphone and joining five minutes early.
passages.levelRationale: A past problem leads to two practical recommendations for future work.

chunks.text: During yesterday's call, several people could not hear the speaker clearly.
For our next meeting, I suggest testing the microphone and joining five minutes early.

passages.title: Choosing a Lunch Place
passages.text: The cafe near our office is convenient, although it becomes noisy at noon. I prefer the smaller restaurant because we can talk without raising our voices.
passages.levelRationale: The speaker compares two options and gives a reasoned preference.

chunks.text: The cafe near our office is convenient, although it becomes noisy at noon.
I prefer the smaller restaurant because we can talk without raising our voices.
